description: Fetch a single occurrence record by its GBIF occurrence key. Returns the complete Darwin Core record — all coordinates, elevation and depth, administrative geography (GADM levels 0–3), dates, collections metadata, collector identifiers and record number, type status, establishment means, the accepted taxon behind a synonym, conservation status, license, rights holder, publishing organization, media links with their rights holders, and quality issue flags. Check occurrenceStatus before reading the record as a sighting: NOT_DETECTED (ABSENT or NOT_DETECTED in the occurrenceStatus filter) means a survey looked for the taxon and did not find it. Use the occurrence key from gbif_search_occurrences results.

occurrenceKey.description: GBIF occurrence key from gbif_search_occurrences results.

name: gbif_get_occurrence

acceptedScientificName.description: Scientific name of the accepted taxon as GBIF writes it, with authorship where GBIF has one (e.g. "Quercus castanea Née") — the accepted counterpart of scientificName. May be absent.

acceptedTaxonKey.description: Backbone taxon key of the accepted taxon. Equals taxonKey for a record filed under an accepted name; when taxonomicStatus is SYNONYM, taxonKey is the synonym and this is the taxon it resolves to. Passed as taxonKey to the occurrence tools, it covers the accepted taxon and every synonym. May be absent.

catalogNumber.description: Catalog number within the collection. May be absent.

classKey.description: Backbone taxon key for the class. May be absent.

collectionCode.description: Collection code within the institution. May be absent.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Coordinate uncertainty radius in meters. May be absent.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. May be absent.

decimalLatitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84). May be absent.

decimalLongitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84). May be absent.

depth.description: Depth in meters below the local surface, such as a water surface. May be absent.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level. May be absent.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: The occurrenceKey does not exist in GBIF. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

establishmentMeans.description: How the organism came to be at the location (e.g. native, introduced), as the GBIF concept name the establishmentMeans filter takes unchanged. May be absent.

eventDate.description: Observation date as ISO 8601 string. May be absent.

eventTime.description: Time of day of the observation, with seconds and UTC offset (e.g. 20:15:00+01:00) — the offset eventDate omits when it carries a local time. May be absent.

gadm.description: GADM administrative geography — stable GIDs and names at levels 0–3. May be absent.

level0.description: GADM level 0 — country. May be absent.

gid.description: GADM GID — stable administrative-unit identifier (e.g. SWE, SWE.2_1). Pass it as gadmGid to gbif_search_occurrences, gbif_count_occurrences, or gbif_occurrence_facets to filter on this unit. May be absent.

level1.description: GADM level 1 — state/province. May be absent.

gid.description: GADM GID — stable administrative-unit identifier (e.g. SWE, SWE.2_1). Pass it as gadmGid to gbif_search_occurrences, gbif_count_occurrences, or gbif_occurrence_facets to filter on this unit. May be absent.

level2.description: GADM level 2 — county/district. May be absent.

gid.description: GADM GID — stable administrative-unit identifier (e.g. SWE, SWE.2_1). Pass it as gadmGid to gbif_search_occurrences, gbif_count_occurrences, or gbif_occurrence_facets to filter on this unit. May be absent.

level3.description: GADM level 3 — municipality/ward, the finest level GBIF indexes. Absent where the country does not subdivide that far.

gid.description: GADM GID — stable administrative-unit identifier (e.g. SWE, SWE.2_1). Pass it as gadmGid to gbif_search_occurrences, gbif_count_occurrences, or gbif_occurrence_facets to filter on this unit. May be absent.

identifiers.description: Alternative record identifiers from the source. May be absent.

items.description: An alternative identifier for the occurrence record.

identifier.description: The identifier value. May be absent.

type.description: Identifier type (e.g. URL, DOI, GBIF_PORTAL). May be absent.

individualCount.description: Number of individuals. May be absent.

institutionCode.description: Code of the contributing institution. May be absent.

iucnRedListCategory.description: IUCN Red List category of the taxon — CR Critically Endangered, EN Endangered, VU Vulnerable, NT Near Threatened, LC Least Concern, DD Data Deficient, EX Extinct, EW Extinct in the Wild, CD Conservation Dependent. May be absent.

license.description: License the record is published under, as the Creative Commons URL GBIF stores (e.g. http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/legalcode). The license filter on the occurrence tools takes the matching code instead — CC0_1_0, CC_BY_4_0, or CC_BY_NC_4_0 — not this URL. May be absent.

lifeStage.description: Life stage of the individual(s). May be absent.

media.description: Associated media (images, audio, video). May be absent.

items.description: A media item (image, audio, video) associated with the occurrence.

rightsHolder.description: Rights holder to credit for the media item. May be absent.

occurrenceID.description: Darwin Core occurrenceID — the source record identifier, often a URL back to the origin record. May be absent.

occurrenceStatus.description: Whether the record asserts presence or absence: DETECTED when the taxon was there, NOT_DETECTED when it documents a survey that looked and did not find it. GBIF serves these spellings; the occurrenceStatus filter also takes the older PRESENT and ABSENT, which select the same records. A NOT_DETECTED record is not a sighting — it carries coordinates, a date, and a recorder all the same. May be absent.

publishingCountry.description: Country code of the publishing organization.

publishingOrganizationKey.description: UUID of the organization that published the record — GBIF's publishingOrgKey. Pass it as publishingOrg to the occurrence tools or gbif_search_datasets. May be absent.

recordNumber.description: Number the collector assigned when collecting (e.g. "JL 157") — how herbarium specimens are cited, beside recordedBy. Not the catalogNumber. May be absent.

rightsHolder.description: Person or organization that owns or manages rights over the record — the name to credit under a CC BY license. May be absent.

sex.description: Sex of the individual(s). May be absent.

stateProvince.description: State or province. May be absent.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank of the identified taxon.

taxonomicStatus.description: Status of the identification carried on this record — ACCEPTED, PROVISIONALLY_ACCEPTED, SYNONYM, DOUBTFUL, and so on. Says whether the occurrence was filed under an accepted name or a synonym. May be absent.

typeStatus.description: Nomenclatural type status of the specimen (e.g. Holotype, Isolectotype), as the GBIF concept name the typeStatus filter takes unchanged. May be absent.

title: Get Occurrence Record
